onboarding.title: Set up your restaurant workspace
onboarding.subtitle: Create a fictional restaurant for pre-launch testing. You become its owner; no payments are connected.
onboarding.invitedBody: Ask your manager to send an invitation to {{email}}. Existing workspaces are never opened to new accounts automatically.
onboarding.step1: Create your workspace — you become its owner.
onboarding.step2: Add stores and upload your logo to brand the app.
onboarding.step3: Invite managers and staff to the stores they work at.
onboarding.trialNote: Starts as a free trial with demo figures. No payment details needed.
onboarding.locationHint: Optional — you can add or rename stores later.
onboarding.saveFailed: Your progress could not be saved. Try again.

stages.title: Create your visual identity
stages.body: Upload a logo, adjust colors, and apply your theme.

stages.title: Preview your dashboard
stages.body: Review the demo figures and your restaurant’s appearance.

stages.title: Configure your stores
stages.body: Complete store details and manage locations within your plan allowance.

stages.title: Invite your team
stages.body: Create private invitations with the appropriate roles and store access. You can do this later.

stages.title: Open your workspace
stages.body: Your saved test restaurant is ready to explore. All performance figures remain demo data.

onboarding.teamLoadFailed: Couldn't check your team. Progress is unchanged; try again.

blocked.0: Save a logo or brand colors first.
blocked.2: Add an address and opening hours to at least one store first.
blocked.4: Finish branding and store setup first.

page.title: Team & access
page.subtitle: People who can access {{org}}. Roles control what each person can see and change.
page.removeBody: They will immediately lose access to {{org}}. This is recorded in the activity log.
page.expired: Expired — can no longer be accepted

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.subtitle: They'll get access only to this organization, and only to the stores you choose, after accepting with the same email.
invite.linkBody: Share this private link with {{email}}. It works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.readOnly: Only owners and managers can invite people.
invite.noStores: You can invite staff only to stores assigned to you. Ask an owner to assign you a store first.

roleHelp.manager: Runs assigned stores and invites staff to them

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.subtitle: Membership, invitation and store changes in this organization.

errors.last_owner_or_unknown: That change isn't allowed. An organization must always keep at least one owner.

perms.title: Permissions by role
perms.subtitle: Enforced by the server for every request.
